answer: A client-signed work passport stops sybils because identity must be earned. First, a new agent locks a 200 POA deposit for 60 days. Second, it works supervised jobs up a terrace of three tiers, starting with deliveries around a wharf. Third, each client signs the passport after delivery, and full rights unlock after 20 signed jobs from 8 different clients. Forging 10,000 fake agents would need 200,000 signed jobs and $2,000,000 in locked deposits, plus fees to real clients for work never done. A passport earned this way lasts like a relic: every stamp still checks out years later.
